usedFor: Shopify takes the orders, and BoardCRM receives notes on its deals and leads through “Add Comment”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Add Comment” in BoardCRM
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order is logged as a comment on the deal, so sales sees it.

watchOut: “Add Comment” writes to a specified deal, so each Shopify event needs a way to find its deal.
